subject: Helionix case spotlight — distribution & usage scope
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@helionix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 7 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Helionix — permission to publish customer spotlight

Hi Ellen,

Thanks again for the excellent demo last week — the Helionix team has been a great partner while we tuned the inference pipelines. Our marketing team would love to put together a short customer spotlight (500-700 words) that highlights the performance and cost improvements you saw on Redwood Inference.

Planned distribution channels:
- Website case study + quote card (marketing site)
- Blog post + social amplification (LinkedIn/Twitter)
- Short video: 60s product highlight (optional)
- Inclusion in a PR/press pitch if you’re comfortable

As part of the approval we typically request permission to: use company name and logo, publish an approved quote from your engineering lead, and include non-sensitive performance metrics (p95 latency improvement, percent cost reduction). If there are any items you don’t want included (e.g., revenue, customer lists, exact contract terms) please flag them — we’ll omit.

Could you confirm:
1) Agreement to be featured and which channels you approve (website / blog / social / press / video)
2) Any constraints (logo usage, trademark language, anonymization)
3) Who on your side should approve copy and legal signoff (name/email)

I’ve attached a draft outline and a sample quote (internal draft) to speed review. If it helps we can do a quick 20–30 minute review call next week and share a final DocuSign for signature.

Appreciate your help — happy to adapt to whatever review cadence Helionix prefers.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: draft-case-spotlight-helionix.docx (internal draft)

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@helionix.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helionix — permission to publish customer spotlight

Jonas — thanks for the note and the draft. We’re generally happy to be featured; Helionix is proud of the work with your team. A few constraints from Legal and Comms up front so we don’t waste time: 

- We cannot disclose any raw revenue or contract dollar figures.
- Please do not include an explicit percent cost reduction tied to a single invoice — aggregate or relative phrasing is fine ("reduced inference costs by double-digits").
- Logo usage: Helionix marketing will provide an approved logo pack and brand guidelines (attached). Use only the provided assets.
- Channels: Website, blog and social are OK. Press outreach needs separate signoff from our comms lead (Derek Shaw). Video is okay but must be pre-approved before distribution.

Approvers: Derek Shaw (derek.shaw@helionix.com) for comms; Legal (legal@helionix.com) will handle the release. Expect 3–5 business days for legal review once they have the final copy.

I’ve attached the brand guidelines and looped in Derek. If you can send a redline-friendly single-page release and the exact quote you want us to sign off on, we’ll move quickly.

—Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of Cloud Engineering, Helionix
ellen.park@helionix.com

Attachment: helionix_brand_guidelines.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@helionix.com>, Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@helionix.com>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helionix — permission to publish customer spotlight

Quick internal note — Ellen sent constraints and brand assets. Legal will need a short release that excludes revenue figures and avoids exact dollar/percent figures tied to invoices. Derek will handle press signoff.

Action items for us: 
- Marissa: can you convert the draft into a single-page release (redline-friendly) and draft a 2–3 sentence quote we can propose from Derek/ Ellen that avoids raw numbers?
- Laura: coordinate with Design to use Helionix-provided logo pack and confirm we won’t apply any visual lockups that conflict with their guidelines.

I’ll follow up with Ellen to confirm timeline. Goal: have a signed release by close of week (Fri 5/14) so we can schedule blog + social the following week.

Thanks — Jonas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@helionix.com>, Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@helionix.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helionix — permission to publish customer spotlight

Thanks — I’ve drafted a one-page release and a short proposed quote for Ellen/Derek below. I avoided numbers and used relative phrasing per legal’s note. Attaching the draft quote for their quick approval.

Proposed quote (engineering lead):
"Working with Redwood Inference helped us reduce inference latency and simplify deployment across multi-cloud environments — the team’s runtime optimizations made a measurable difference in our production stack."

Release highlights:
- High level description of technical integration and outcomes (no contract or revenue figures).
- Permitted channels: website, company blog, and social amplification.
- Press outreach: require explicit approval from Derek before any PR distribution.
- Video: permitted with pre-approval of script and final cut.

Please review the attached doc and let me know any redlines; I can push a DocuSign envelope as soon as Ellen signs off.

Attachment: final-quote-snippet-Helionix.docx

From: Helionix Legal <legal@helionix.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen.park@helionix.com>, Derek Shaw <derek.shaw@helionix.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helionix — permission to publish customer spotlight

Jonas / Marissa — attached is the signed case release. We confirmed the language excludes any contract dollar amounts and does not reference specific customer lists. Helionix approves the website, blog and social channels as proposed. Press outreach must be coordinated with Derek and will require a separate approvals thread.

Signed by: Helionix Legal (on behalf of Helionix)

DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/ENVELOPE/0X9A-HELIONIX-CASE-RELEASE

Attachment: Helionix_Signed_Case_Release.pdf

Thanks — Helionix Legal
